sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
This petition is directed against the order passed by the competent authority under the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 dated 28.2.2024 contained in annexure-4 to the writ petition.
Various grounds are urged in respect of the challenge to such order.

Learned State counsel, however, raises a preliminary objection to the maintainability of the writ petition as the petitioner has the remedy of approaching the Food Safety Policy Tribunal in terms of Section 70 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006.

Munish Kumar vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 2 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99335678/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Once the statute clearly provides for alternative remedy, we would not be justified in embarking upon a factual enquiry with regard to correctness of the order passed by the competent authority, at the first instance.
Writ petition is, consequently, dismissed on the ground of alternate remedy.

Order Date :- 2.1.2025 RA  Munish Kumar vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 2 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99335678/
